text_block_list.text:
After blasting through the Classics,
Марузенски
takes on the last big race of
the year, the Arima
Kinen...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is where the best of the best in the
classic
and senior years come together in
one place.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It's going to be so much fun! I can't wait
to get
started!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Watch, I'm going to be running at the
head of the
pack against the top racers
around!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: Time for you to become a Grand Prix champion!

text_block_list.text:
You know it! Standing on that podium is
going to
be so rad!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Even the paddock is packed with

spectators!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски! Show us another
out-of-this-world
run!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text: Good luck! We'll be rooting for you!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: ...Oh! You ran with me in the Asahi Hai.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: I'm... just a spectator today... B-but...
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate

text_block_list.text:
I'll run with you again someday! I'm
gonna catch
up to you!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate

text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering for you, so you'd better
win,
okay?!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume Classmate

text_block_list.text: I'll give you a race to admire!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
